description: Prepares a sale of a launch token for ETH, with the exact-amount approval step if needed. Simulates step 1 on-chain. Returns unsigned transactions, a summary, and a signing link. Accepts an amount or a percent of the wallet balance.

amount.description: Token base units (18 decimals) as a decimal string.

from.description: The wallet address that will sign (0x...). Never a private key. Omit it when a walletToken is passed — the wallet is resolved from the token instead.

percentOfBalance.description: Percent of the wallet balance, 1 to 100. Use instead of amount.

ref.description: Attribution tag for traffic measurement. Default "grok".

returnUrl.description: Optional https:// link back to your agent flow. The signing page shows it as a button after the transaction confirms, with ?tx=<hash>&status=confirmed added. Anything that is not an https:// URL is ignored.

slippageBps.description: Slippage limit in basis points. Default 100, maximum 1000.

token.description: Symbol, name, token address, or launch address.

walletToken.description: A wallet token from /sign?connect=1: connect once, store the token, and pass it instead of from on every prepare call. The wallet is resolved from the token (signature-checked, 90-day expiry). When both are passed they must name the same wallet.

name: polypad_prepare_sell
title: Prepare a sell
